**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

Section 18 already carries every preferred element of the INSURANCE rule:

- **CGL** — USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (§18.1)
- **Professional E&O** — USD 2,000,000 (§18.1)
- **Cyber/privacy** — USD 5,000,000, granted unconditionally, so it covers Vendor's processing of our health data (§18.1)
- **Workers' compensation** — as required by law (§18.1)
- **Certificates** — provided on request (§18.2)

The clause also adds protections that run in our favour (term plus one year, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, reputable insurers, primacy over our insurance, cancellation/material-reduction notice, and express non-limitation of Vendor's liabilities). No redline proposed.
